examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

items.wordHook: 韓(the name Korea) + 國(country) → 韓國(Korea).

examples.chinese: 你只買了一份雞排，吃得飽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ mǎi le yí fèn jīpái, chī de bǎo ma?
examples.english: You only bought one chicken cutlet; are you full from eating it?

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 鞋子的尺寸很重要，太大或是太小都不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi de chǐcùn hěn zhòngyào, tài dà huòshì tài xiǎo dōu bù shūfu.
examples.english: The size of shoes is very important; whether too big or too small, they are uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 上網買鞋子前先比一下腳的大小，才知道選哪個尺寸。
examples.pinyin: Shàngwǎng mǎi xiézi qián xiān bǐ yīxià jiǎo de dàxiǎo, cái zhīdào xuǎn nǎge chǐcùn.
examples.english: Before buying shoes online, first measure the size of your feet, only then will you know which size to choose.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 我的腰越來越胖，現在買的褲子尺寸比以前大了兩號。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yāo yuèláiyuè pàng, xiànzài mǎi de kùzi chǐcùn bǐ yǐqián dàle liǎng hào.
examples.english: My waist is getting fatter and fatter; the size of pants I buy now is two sizes larger than before.

examples.chinese: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒujī gōngsī de fēnxī, míngnián dà chǐcùn shǒujī de shìchǎng xūqiú huì tígāo wǔ bèi yǐshàng.
examples.english: According to the cell phone company's analysis, next year the market demand for large-size cell phones will increase by more than five times.

items.wordHook: a 尸(body) stretches out straight for measuring → 尺(ruler).

examples.chinese: 這一類的中文小說都放在圖書館的二樓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yī lèi de Zhōngwén xiǎoshuō dōu fàng zài túshūguǎn de èr lóu.
examples.english: Chinese novels of this category are all placed on the second floor of the library.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì shūcài shuǐguǒ de zhǒnglèi hěn duō, kě tígōng mínzhòng jiào duō de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: That supermarket has many kinds of vegetables and fruits, which can provide people with more choices.

examples.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The stationery store sells many kinds of stationery, such as pens, backpacks, notebooks, and other student supplies; not only is the quality good, but the price is also not expensive.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 會議資料的分類不必太仔細，分得簡單清楚就行了。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zīliào de fēnlèi bùbì tài zǐxì, fēn de jiǎndān qīngchu jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The classification of meeting materials doesn't need to be too detailed; as long as it's simple and clear, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 人類大腦分成幾區，有的管語言，有的管記憶，很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi dànǎo fēnchéng jǐ qū, yǒude guǎn yǔyán, yǒude guǎn jìyì, hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: The human brain is divided into several areas; some manage language, some manage memory—it's very interesting.

examples.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
examples.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
examples.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

examples.chinese: 用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
examples.pinyin: Yòng rénlèi de jiǎodù qù kàn dàzìrán, jiù kàn bù chū dàzìrán de běnlái jiàzhí.
examples.english: Looking at nature from a human perspective, you cannot see nature's original value.

examples.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
examples.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
examples.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

items.wordHook: A 米(rice) 犬(dog) tilts its 頁(head) when sorting each grain into a 類(category).

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 我有一個幸福美滿的家庭，父母都很愛我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge xìngfú měimǎn de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
examples.english: I have a happy and fulfilling family; my parents both love me very much.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。那個杯子裡裝滿了水。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以假日常常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: That restaurant's food is both cheap and delicious, so it is often fully occupied on holidays.

examples.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
examples.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
examples.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

examples.chinese: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng duì nóngyè hěn yǒu xìngqù, jiālǐ de cāngkù bǎi mǎn le zhòngtián yòng de gōngjù.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very interested in agriculture; the warehouse at home is filled with tools for farming.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān yīnwèi bù shǎo rén fàngjià, dà bùfèn cāntīng dōu kèmǎn le.
examples.english: On New Year's Day, because many people had the day off, most restaurants were full.

examples.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
examples.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
examples.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

items.wordHook: Water 氵(water) pours until it fills the container level to the brim → 滿(full).

examples.chinese: 在路邊的攤子享受小吃，得注意他們處理食物的方式衛不衛生。
examples.pinyin: Zài lùbiān de tānzi xiǎngshòu xiǎochī, děi zhùyì tāmen chǔlǐ shíwù de fāngshì wèi bù wèishēng.
examples.english: When enjoying snacks at roadside stalls, you need to pay attention to whether their way of handling food is hygienic or not.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge páizi de wèishēngzhǐ dǎ bā zhé, hěn duō rén qiǎng zhe gòumǎi.
examples.english: This brand of toilet paper is 20% off; many people are rushing to buy it.

examples.chinese: 家裡的衛生紙快用完了，下班回家時順便買幾卷吧。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ de wèishēngzhǐ kuài yòng wán le, xiàbān huí jiā shí shùnbiàn mǎi jǐ juǎn ba.
examples.english: The toilet paper at home is almost used up; on your way home from work, buy a few rolls while you're at it.

examples.chinese: 今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xuéxiào de yùsuàn zhǐ gòu xiūlǐ sùshè de wèishēng shèbèi, qítā xūyào gǎishàn de zhǐ néng děng dào míngnián le.
examples.english: This year the school's budget is only enough to repair the dormitory's sanitary facilities; other things that need improvement can only wait until next year.

examples.chinese: 旅行團的行程及路線是公司及導遊決定的，不喜歡的話，就只能自助旅遊了。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán de xíngchéng jí lùxiàn shì gōngsī jí dǎoyóu juédìng de, bù xǐhuān de huà, jiù zhǐ néng zìzhù lǚyóu le.
examples.english: The itinerary and route of a tour group are decided by the company and the tour guide; if you don't like it, then you can only travel independently.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 這條魚很好吃，你多吃點兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú hěn hǎochī, nǐ duō chī diǎnr.
examples.english: This fish is delicious, eat a little more.

examples.chinese: 那條裙子很漂亮，可是非常貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang, kěshì fēicháng guì.
examples.english: That skirt is very pretty, but it is very expensive.

examples.chinese: 現在這條街上沒有車。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zhè tiáo jiē shàng méiyǒu chē.
examples.english: There are no cars on this street now.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡這條裙子的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān zhè tiáo qúnzi de yánsè.
examples.english: I don't really like the color of this skirt.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有兩條捷運線。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu liǎng tiáo jiéyùn xiàn.
examples.english: There are two MRT lines near my home.

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
examples.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) takes a light 攵(rap) to the 木(tree), stripping a branch → one 條(measure word for roads).
Combining 品(article) and 質(essence): 品質 means quality.
Combining 孝(filial piety) and 順(submit to): 孝順 means filial piety.
Drawing a taut hunting 弓(bow) with the enduring tenacity of a resilient 虫(insect) proves a warrior is 強(strong).
In the 田(field), 力(strength) works from dawn to dusk → that worker is 男(male).
